"''We have our orders, Emir.|Wat Tambor and TA-175|audio=WeHaveOurOrders-LoR.flac|}} '''TA-175''' was a [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]] that served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Start my ship. Wat Tambor is a fool.|TA-175|}} [[File:TA-175-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|TA-175 prepares to depart Lessu]] During the Separatist's occupation of [[Ryloth]], TA-175 served under the command of [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]]. The droid suggested that they retreat from the [[city]] of [[Lessu City|Lessu]], because the [[Galactic Republic]] would be able to take it soon, but Tambor refused to listen. The Republic forces pressed on, with the help of native [[Twi'lek]] freedom fighters. Again, TA-175 suggested a retreat, but Tambor refused, as two [[Multi-Troop Transport]]s full of stolen treasure were arriving. It was these [[transport]]s that allowed two Republic [[Advanced Recon Force trooper|ARF]] [[clone trooper]]s, [[Stak]] and [[Razor]], to infiltrate the city and activate the [[plasma bridge]] leading to Lessu. This permitted the Republic and Twi'lek attack to continue. After Tambor continued to delay departing, even after being ordered by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to do so, TA-175 decided Emir Tambor was a fool and left, departing in Tambor's own [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|shuttle]]. The tactical droid then informed [[Count]] [[Dooku]] that Tambor had been captured, as he was too greedy to retreat in time. {{Droid-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} {{1st}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of TA-175}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/liberty-on-ryloth-episode-guide|text="Liberty on Ryloth" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Hyena-class Droid Bomber Expansion Pack|cardname=TA-175}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|wat-tambor|Wat Tambor}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=TA-175 |es=TA-175 |pl=TA-175 }} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:Separatist officers]] [[Category:T-series tactical droids]]
